extract.noResponse: Shown in the value column before the request was sent.
extract.summary: {{example}} is the variable syntax of Gostman with the word variable_name inside double braces. Keep it as given.
extract.savedTo.session: {{names}} is a list of variable names. Session values live in memory only.
extract.savedTo.environment: {{names}} is a list of variable names.
extract.scopes.session: Where an extracted value is kept: in memory until the app closes.
extract.scopes.environment: Where an extracted value is kept: saved with the active environment.
extract.variable: Column label: the name of the variable that receives the value.
extract.from: Column label: where the value is read from (body, header, cookie, status).
extract.path: Column label: a JSONPath, header name or cookie name.
extract.value: Column label: the value found in the last response.
extract.keepIn: Column label: where the value is kept.
extract.run: Accessible label of the checkbox that enables an extract rule.
extract.namePlaceholder: Example variable name; keep letters, digits and underscores.
extract.runNow: Button that applies the rules to the last response again.
